notes: Turn: `hermes chat --query="reply with OK" -Q -m nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free --provider openrouter` (free OpenRouter model); the key came from OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment, so nothing was staged. This host has no ~/.hermes/config.yaml, .env or auth.json.
First use in a fresh HERMES_HOME downloads the ~38 MB tirith scanner into bin/ over the network and writes .update_check; the install dir is under mise, not the home.
hermes_constants.py resolves HERMES_HOME from the process environment (read in the package source), falling back to ~/.hermes.
The runner (hermes-runner.ts) spawns `hermes chat --query` once per tool round with env = process.env + args.env, so HERMES_HOME set in args.env reaches every round.
